### To claim this issue

Open a comment with `/claim` and include the following, pasting the confirmation exactly as written. See the [paid contributor terms](https://github.com/HHS/simpler-grants-protocol/blob/main/PAID_CONTRIBUTOR_TERMS.md).

```md
/claim

- [x] I confirm that I am a United States person aged eighteen or over, that I meet the eligibility requirements in section 1 of the paid contributor terms, that I have read and I agree to the paid contributor terms, and that any work I submit is mine to contribute.

GitHub username: @your-username
Does your organization benefit from this work? If yes, how:
How I plan to approach this: one line
```

The program administrator will assign the issue and post your deadline. Please do not start substantial work before the issue is assigned to you.

Once you're assigned, email commongrants-contributors@agile6.com with your GitHub username and a link to the issue, so we can reach you privately about payment.

Your pull request title should follow the [title format in CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/HHS/simpler-grants-protocol/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pr-title-format). If it doesn't, a maintainer will fix it before merging.

### Claims

_Maintained by the program administrator. The first complete claim is assigned. The others are listed in the order they claimed and are offered the issue if it comes free._
